limitations: Includes parcel 400 behind parcel 401; cadastral geometry does not verify ownership.
House floor (+1.2 m), eye levels, glazing, terrace, canopy and landscape are adjustable design assumptions, not a measured building survey.
Five apartment volumes are sampled. Coverage means blocked sample rays from one selected observer, not area percentage or a whole-garden privacy guarantee.
Hedges are ideal continuous opaque screens, not porous or tapered individual plants. Existing vegetation is not modelled.
PCK 3 returns above absolute elevation 24 m are isolated thin features of unconfirmed identity and excluded unless high features are enabled.
Farther blocks use median LoD1 roofs; their roof objects and true maxima may be higher.
Own-house walls, window apertures and existing tree crowns are excluded from analytical coverage. Nearby mapped buildings are approximate flat-roof blockers.
Moving garden grade does not move the house floor. Existing hedge tops remain fixed when new planting is disabled.
A raised garden is a geometry experiment, not drainage, foundation or retaining-wall approval.
